# Code on the Go (GPL-3.0)

GEIVIA provides an optional bridge to open projects in **Code on the Go**,  
an open-source Android IDE by App Dev for All. This repository does not currently bundle Code on the Go source code or binaries.

- Project: https://github.com/appdevforall/CodeOnTheGo
- Website: https://appdevforall.org/code-on-the-go/
- License: GNU General Public License v3.0
- Copyright: App Dev for All and contributors
- Successor of AndroidIDE (archived)

## License obligations

Code on the Go is licensed under GPL-3.0. If GEIVIA later bundles or derives code from it,
that distribution must:

- Remain under GPL-3.0
- Make the complete corresponding source available
- Preserve copyright and license notices

## Current status

This directory documents the optional integration point. Full integration is not yet included; GEIVIA currently launches the separately installed app when available.

See also: ../README.md and the root LICENSE file.
